title: Alignment Member Relief on Apportioned Mounting — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
Member labor relief applies to the replacement ticket's mounting charge used to apportion a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty treadwear adjustment credit between a workmanship share and the replacement ticket. It follows the vehicle's plan under Alignment Services & Plans:

- **Active lifetime alignment plan** (Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan or Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance): 10% of the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire is relieved.
- **Active Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan or Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan:** 5% of it is relieved.
- **Any other vehicle:** nothing is relieved.

Each relief is worked out on its own on the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire, and the mounting charge less every relief taken off it is never below 0.

**Worked (hypothetical $30.00 mounting charge):** lifetime plan — $3.00 relieved; 3-year plan — $1.50; a single four-wheel alignment with no plan — nothing.
